description_en: Enables resource group management for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instance in elastic storage mode. After resource group management is enabled, the resource management mode of the instance is changed from resource queue to resource group
description_zh: 为AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版存储弹性模式6.0实例开启资源组管理，开启后实例的资源管理模式会从资源队列切换到资源组
name: EnableDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
